description: Pass/fail criteria for hospital accreditation survey results (Paripurna, Utama, Madya, Tidak terakreditasi) under STARKES 2024, transcribed from the official survey guideline. Chapter counts exclude the Program Nasional chapter, which is scored separately. 'all_applicable_except_prognas' means every applicable chapter other than PROGNAS (15 of 16 when PPK applies; PPK is not applicable to non-teaching hospitals).
